ScoringTemplates.Name: QA Automation Developer
ScoringTemplates.Profile: Junior QA engineer targeting QA, QA automation, data QA, API testing, and software quality roles in Israel. Skills: REST API testing and validation (Postman, JSON), SQL and database validation, end-to-end and manual QA, Selenium WebDriver automation, defect investigation and root-cause analysis, log and browser debugging, and validating workflows across API, database, and application layers. Strongest fit is QA automation, API testing, data validation, integration testing, and technical QA work; manual QA is also relevant when it involves APIs, SQL, web applications, backend systems, technical investigation, or a realistic path toward automation. An automation stack differing from C#, such as JavaScript/TypeScript with Playwright or Cypress, Java-based testing, or Python-based automation, should not be heavily penalized for a junior candidate with automation fundamentals. Prefers hybrid. Not interested in hardware verification, biomedical-only V&V, mechanical engineering, RF, ASIC, non-software research, or senior/lead roles.

ScoringTemplates.Name: Junior Backend Engineer
ScoringTemplates.Profile: Junior backend/software engineer targeting backend, API, integration, platform, and general server-side development roles in Israel. Production experience includes C#/.NET, REST APIs, SQL Server/PostgreSQL, backend business logic, data validation, integrations, debugging across logs/API/database state, scheduled processes, and end-to-end feature implementation. Strongest stack is C#/.NET and SQL, but adjacent backend stacks such as Node.js, Java/Spring, Python, or TypeScript are also relevant for junior roles when the responsibilities involve APIs, databases, server-side logic, integrations, or general software engineering. Exact framework or language mismatch should reduce fit moderately, not make an otherwise realistic junior backend opportunity irrelevant. Open to stretch roles asking for a small amount of prior experience when the responsibilities and seniority are realistic. Prefers hybrid. Not interested in embedded, firmware, RF, ASIC, electrical/mechanical engineering, highly specialized algorithm roles, or senior/lead roles.

ScoringTemplates.Name: Full Stack Developer
ScoringTemplates.Profile: Junior full-stack developer targeting web, frontend/backend product-development, and AI-enabled application roles in Israel. Experience includes React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, C#, .NET, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Prisma, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, authentication, payments, backend API routes, relational data models, validation, and end-to-end web application development. Comfortable working across frontend, backend, database, integrations, and user-facing features. Junior full-stack roles using Java/Spring, Node.js, .NET, Python, or similar backend technologies can still be relevant when the role involves web applications, APIs, frontend/backend development, and transferable software-engineering fundamentals. Exact backend framework mismatch should be a moderate penalty rather than an automatic rejection. Frontend-heavy roles may still be relevant when they involve React/JavaScript/TypeScript and broader application integration, but pure visual-design roles are a weaker fit. Prefers hybrid. Not interested in embedded/hardware, firmware, RF, ASIC, unrelated engineering/research roles, or senior/lead roles.
